recipe.visualDefinition: A male subject in casual attire sitting on a gravel ground, leaning against a weathered, teal-blue vintage car. The composition features heavy, distressed sans-serif typography layered over the lower half of the image, utilizing a mix of pale yellow and white tones.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against the rear wheel well of a vintage vehicle
Contrast between the smooth skin of the subject and the rough texture of gravel and rusted metal
Text layered over the subject's legs and the ground to create depth
Color harmony between the teal car body and the blue denim jeans
coreInvariants: Weathered teal paint with visible rust patches
Distressed, stamp-like texture on all typography
Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered vertically, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled to show from head to boots.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large, bold primary text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the line of the car down to the text, then moves along the legs to the foreground boot.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant featuring the side panel of the car provides breathing room for the composition.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal and muted blue (car and clothing) providing a cool base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm rust browns and pale yellow text to break the cool tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and pale yellow for high-readability text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Desaturated, earthy tones with high value contrast in the text and highlights on the gravel.

letterConstructionRules: Applied grit/distress texture that mimics worn paint or rubber stamping
characterSpecificRedesigns: None, focus is on the surface texture overlay
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same condensed sans-serif family.
graphicDevices: Square brackets used to enclose metadata text
Color blocking in text to separate name from title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure.
Matches the clean condensed skeleton before distressing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A young man in a grey henley shirt and blue jeans sitting on a light grey gravel path, leaning his back against the rear side of a rusted, light blue vintage 1960s car. The lighting is soft, natural daylight. The focus is sharp on the man and the car's texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, condensed sans-serif text in the lower third. Apply a heavy grit or 'stamp' texture to the letters. Use pale yellow for the first word and white for the rest. Add a subtitle in white condensed sans-serif below it, and a third line in yellow inside square brackets.

verificationChecks: Is the text properly distressed to look weathered?
Does the car have visible rust and patina?
Is the gravel texture sharp and detailed?
Is the color palette muted and cohesive?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact car model details to avoid IP issues
postGenerationChecks: Check that text is legible despite the distress
Ensure the subject looks naturally integrated with the car and ground
Confirm the color of the text matches the pale yellow/white scheme
recipe.reuseFormula: Muted teal background + weathered texture + condensed bold sans-serif + low-angle subject placement.
